title: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery of New England files for review and approval a Firm Transportation Agreement with Bardon Trimount Corporation d/b/a Aggregate Industries (Haynnis, MA).
petitioner: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also find that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Judith F. Judson, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Brian Paul Golden, and Soo J. Kim. (DTE 06-GC-21)
